summary: Ericsson filed a Form 6-K (equivalent to a US current report on Form 8-K) announcing open-market share repurchases of its Class B shares (ISIN SE0000108656) during September 7-11, 2026. It bought 1,849,987 shares at a volume-weighted average of SEK 97.0493, totaling SEK 179,539,931.56, under a SEK 15 billion buyback program announced April 16, 2026 and running through March 31, 2027, executed via Goldman Sachs Bank Europe SE on Nasdaq Stockholm. Treasury stock now totals 107,518,663 Class B shares. The board intends to propose canceling repurchased shares at the 2027 AGM; watch ongoing execution pace and cancellation approval.
